{{Quote|Senator Aang holds the deciding vote on the Military Oversight Committee. You know how particular the Roonan are. I need everything to be&hellip; perfect.|Padmé Amidala, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Evil Plans" />}}
'''Aang''' was a [[Roonan/Legends|Roonan]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who served in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A highly particular Roonan, Aang was an important member of the [[Military Oversight Committee/Legends|Senate Military Oversight Committee]], and his vote was recruited by Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] during her campaign to [[Reduced military spending bill/Legends|curb]] the Republic's spending on the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] war effort. Ultimately, however, Amidala's efforts failed, and the Senate instead voted to [[Republic military enhancement bill/Legends|increase]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] spending to [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|fund]] the [[Cloning/Legends|production]] of five million additional [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|To the signing of the treaty. And to my favorite dessert, jogan fruitcake, yes.|Aang leads a toast at Padmé Amidala's state banquet|<ref name="Evil Plans" />}}
The [[Roonan/Legends|Roonan]] Aang lived during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] rule. A [[Politics/Legends|politician]], he became a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]], which was [[Senate Building/Legends|based]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He eventually attained a seat on the [[Military Oversight Committee/Legends|Senate Military Oversight Committee]],<ref name="Evil Plans" /> a bureau affiliated with the operations of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]].<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], his vote on the committee was considered to be decisive.<ref name="Evil Plans" />

[[File:AangBanquet-EvilPlans.png|thumb|left|250px|Aang attends Senator Amidala's birthday banquet with several of his Senatorial colleagues.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the war's second [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Evil Plans Date">{{TCWdates|308}}</ref> Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] began a campaign to [[Reduced military spending bill/Legends|reduce]] the Republic's spending on the war effort against the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref> She thus tried to persuade Aang to vote with her coalition,<ref name="Evil Plans Ep Guide" /> given his prominence on the Military Oversight Committee. As part of her negotiations with the Roonan, Amidala hosted a state banquet&mdash;one that was said to be the most important party of the season&mdash;in his honor at her [[Naboo Queen (restaurant)|apartment]] on Coruscant.<ref name="Evil Plans" /> The event also served as a celebration for the Roonan's [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]].<ref name="FF-2014 47: Bane">{{FactFile2014|47|20 BBY 1-4|Plot to Free Ziro the Hutt}}</ref> Aang attended the event alongside [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and fellow senators [[Jakker-Sun/Legends|Jakker-Sun]], [[Kin Robb/Legends|Kin Robb]], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], and [[Dantum Roohd/Legends|Dantum Roohd]]. At the banquet, Amidala made sure to serve Aang's favorite dessert, [[Jogan fruitcake/Legends|jogan fruitcake]],<ref name="Evil Plans" /> despite the rarity of fresh [[Jogan fruit/Legends|jogan fruit]] on Coruscant.<ref name="Evil Plans Dataclip">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a250ab02c18a59a012c1d968a100084|text=Dataclip: Evil Plans|na=video file}}</ref> Aang thereafter agreed to sign a treaty and support her campaign, leading a toast in honor of his decision.<ref name="Evil Plans" />

Aang was later present in the Senate when Senator [[Gume Saam/Legends|Gume Saam]] proposed a [[Republic financial reform bill/Legends|measure]] for the deregulation of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] to gain access to [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|funds]] for the war effort. Despite Amidala's efforts to establish [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|peace negotiations]] with the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]], the Senate ultimately voted in favor of Saam's bill in light of a [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|Separatist attack]] on Coruscant's [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|power generator]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> Even with Aang's support,<ref name="Evil Plans" /> Amidala's initiative to reduce military spending soon suffered a similar end, with the Senate rejecting it and instead electing to [[Republic military enhancement bill/Legends|fund]]<ref name="Senate Murders" /><ref name="Chee Twitter Spending Bill">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/10941008766308352|[[Leland Chee]]|date=2010-12-03|quote=For those left wondering, we learned in Season 2 Senate Murders that the military spending increase passed anyway.|nolive=1}}</ref> the [[Cloning/Legends|production]] of five million additional [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The red one, Senator Aang's favorite color is red.|Padmé Amidala, while selecting a dress to wear at the state banquet|<ref name="Evil Plans" />}}
[[File:AangJogan-EvilPlans.png|thumb|right|250px|Aang is served his favorite dessert at Amidala's banquet&mdash;jogan fruitcake.]]
As a Roonan, Aang had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and gray skin.<ref name="Evil Plans" /> Like most members of his [[Species/Legends|species]], he was very particular, and he sometimes mistook the slightest mistake on another's part for a deep insult.<ref name="Evil Plans Dataclip" /> An influential senator of the Republic during the Clone Wars, he came to hold a decisive vote on the Senate Military Oversight Committee.<ref name="Evil Plans" /> Even though fresh jogan [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] was hard to come by on Coruscant,<ref name="Evil Plans Dataclip" /> he greatly enjoyed jogan fruitcake as a dessert, to the point that Padmé Amidala was able to win his support for her military spending reduction measure by serving the dish at a state banquet celebrating his birthday. Aang's favorite color was red,<ref name="Evil Plans" /> and he often wore a suit of red with black [[Boot/Legends|boots]] to official proceedings affiliated with the [[Galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] Senate.<ref name="Evil Plans" /><ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> His high particularity caused Amidala to go to considerable lengths to entertain him; she even chose to wear a red dress at the banquet to please him with his favorite color.<ref name="Evil Plans" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Senator Aang was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series and first appeared in the episode "[[Evil Plans]]," which aired on [[November 5]], [[2010]] as part of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]]. He was voiced by voice actor [[Terrence Carson]],<ref name="Evil Plans Ep Guide" /> who also provided the series' voice for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]].<ref name="Voicing Windu">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20090313.html|text=Terrence "TC" Carson: Voicing Mace Windu}}</ref> Aang was later given a brief cameo appearance in the Senate in the episode "[[Heroes on Both Sides]],"<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> which aired two weeks after "Evil Plans" on [[November 19]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode310.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> Aang's character model was based on that of fellow Roonan senator [[Edcel Bar Gane/Legends|Edcel Bar Gane]], who was originally developed for the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] episode "[[Senate Murders]]."<ref name="Explore: Evil Plans">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/pursuit-of-peace-episode-guide|text="Pursuit of Peace" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> Aang's model later became the basis for another Roonan character, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]], for the third season episode "[[Monster]]."<ref name="Explore: Monster">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep313|text="Monster" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
